text: dsh-sidebar-image-zoom 是面向 DSH Web 的右侧边栏图片预览插件。它通过扩展文档预览注册和文档面板插槽，为 PNG、JPG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、BMP、ICO 与 SVG 图片提供可交互查看器。用户可用滚轮缩放、拖拽平移，并选择适应窗口、适应宽度或 1:1 原始尺寸；工具栏显示当前缩放比例。适合在工作区侧栏查看截图、图表等图片。源码未读取外部数据服务或密钥配置。

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom adds an interactive image viewer to the DSH Web right sidebar. It supports common formats including PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, and SVG. Zoom with the wheel, pan by dragging, or choose fit, fit-width, and 1:1 controls. The toolbar shows the zoom level.
想在 DSH 侧栏里放大查看截图和图表。
图片预览太大或太小，能不能适应窗口或宽度？
I want to zoom and pan images in the DSH workspace sidebar.
dsh-sidebar-image-zoom 的功能「侧栏图片缩放与平移」：在 DSH Web 右侧文档面板中打开支持格式的图片后，可滚轮缩放并以光标位置为中心，也可拖拽平移；工具栏提供适应窗口、适应宽度和 1:1 按钮。
dsh-sidebar-image-zoom 的功能「图片格式识别与预览注册」：插件为 PNG、JPG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、BMP、ICO 和 SVG 后缀注册扩展优先级的文档渲染器，并将图片主体接入右侧文档插槽。

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · dsh-sidebar-image-zoom：A [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that makes the images in the **right-sidebar document pane** zoomable.

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · dsh-sidebar-image-zoom：dsh's built-in image preview is deliberately static — its own source says the image is rendered *"without fitting or scaling them to the pane"*, at intrinsic size, with the surrounding body providing scrolling only. That is fine for icons and painful for big screenshots, diagrams, and charts. This plugin replaces that renderer with one you can actually navigate.

[中文说明 / Chinese README](./README.zh.md)

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Meowrium/dsh-sidebar-image-zoom
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open any image in the right sidebar (new tab → **工作区文件** / workspace files → pick an image).

> Requires the `dsh` 0.1.5 line (this was developed and verified against `0.1.5-rc.1`).
> The right-sidebar document preview this plugin extends does not exist before 0.1.5.

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · Usage：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| **Mouse wheel** | Zoom in/out, **anchored at the cursor** — the pixel under the pointer stays put |
| **Drag** | Pan (once the scaled image is larger than the pane) |
| **Double-click** | Toggle 适应窗口 ↔ 1:1 |
| `适应窗口` | Fit the whole image in the pane |
| `适应宽度` | Fit to pane width only |
| `1:1` | Original size, one image pixel per screen pixel |
| `＋` / `−` | Step zoom |
| `+` / `-` / `0` / `1` | Same, from the keyboard (0 = fit, 1 = 1:1) |

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · Usage：The image opens at **1:1 by default**, matching the built-in feel; a percentage readout sits in the toolbar. Zoom range is 10 % – 1200 %. When the image is smaller than the pane it is centred; when larger, panning is clamped so you cannot drag it out of view.
dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · How it works：It uses only official extension points — no monkey-patching, no private DOM attributes:

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · How it works：- `ctx.documentPreviews.register({ id, extensions, priority: 'extension', loading: 'bytes-complete' })` — the registry's own docs say *"External implementations win over product implementations"*, so the extension band takes over the eight image suffixes (`png jpg jpeg gif webp bmp ico svg`).
- `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.right.tab.document', key: <id> }, Body)` — the keyed document-body seat, under the same id.

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · How it works：The body receives the file as complete bytes (`content.kind === 'bytes'`), turns them into a Blob URL (always revoked on unmount), and renders its own zoom/pan viewport.

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · Package layout：```
package.json       dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml ; dsh.client → lib/client.js
cordis.patch.yml   inserts the bundle entry
lib/index.js       host half (no-op — this plugin is browser-only)
lib/client.js      browser half — the renderer and the zoom body

dsh-sidebar-image-zoom README · Notes：- The plugin only **adds** interaction; it does not change how images are loaded or where they come from.
- Uninstalling it restores dsh's built-in behaviour, because the built-in definition is still registered underneath — this one just outranks it.
- All listeners, styles, observers and object URLs are released on unmount; there is no residue after closing the tab.
